subject: Detect accept4() on specific versions of various platforms (#294)
reason: The change only edits preprocessor platform-detection conditions in src/config.h (HAVE_ACCEPT4 and HAVE_FADVISE) for FreeBSD, DragonFly BSD, NetBSD and OpenBSD. On Linux, where the fuzzer runs, defined(__linux__) satisfied both conditions before and after the change, so both builds compile identically and no runtime behaviour differs; even on the BSDs the macros only select accept4() vs accept()+fcntl() and whether posix_fadvise is used, with no observable protocol or data behaviour change. This is a build/portability change with no testable behaviour difference on the test platform, so no sce
